preconditions.description: The length of the array n must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**4 for x in arr)
preconditions.description: All elements in the array arr must be integers between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the array arr must be equal to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in stdout)
postconditions.description: All elements in the output must be integers.

postconditions.expression: all(x == -1 or arr[i] < arr[j] for i, x in enumerate(stdout) for j in range(i + 1, n) if x == arr[j])
postconditions.description: For each element in the output, if it is not -1, it must be the closest element on the right with a greater frequency than the current element.
